snippet.title: ...Vincent: Mansion of The Dead [Gameplay Trailer]
snippet.description:
...Vincent: Mansion of The Dead is a twin-stick arena shooter with survivors-like mechanics and low-poly pixel art graphics. 

The ghost Winry who lives in her secluded mansion is the prime target of the Dark Lord Thanatos, who wishes to collect her soul. The Dark Lord has deemed that she has lived for too long and is sending his army to collect her debt. Team up with her vessel Vincent and fend off the evil spirits!

Available on Itch.io today, and Steam on Nov 7th!

Itch: https://marinodev.itch.io/vincent
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4103720/Vincent_Mansion_of_The_Dead
